title: DOISST v2.1 input steps remove the 1982-2022 SST cooling of the east equatorial Pacific and 50-60S that in situ, CCI and mooring data show; OI v2 (AMIPII source) keeps it but has a 2018 cold step
abstract: Question: do the satellite-input steps in NOAA DOISST v2.1 change the spatial pattern of 1982-2022 SST trends, and does NOAA OI SST v2 (the post-1981 source of the AMIPII model forcing) have similar artifacts? Approach: we compared both products with three in situ-only products (ERSSTv5, COBE-SST2, HadSST4.2), the satellite-only ESA SST CCI v3.0.1 and TAO/TRITON moorings on 5-degree boxes (60S-60N, fixed ice-free mask). We used block-bootstrap trend intervals, a break search, step models with a goodness-of-fit placebo, and a box-level step correction cross-validated between reference types. Results: DOISST shows no cooling in the east equatorial Pacific (+0.022 C per decade; references -0.046 to -0.001) or at 50-60S (+0.056; references -0.040 to 0.000), and it doubles the 40-60S warming. At 38 east Pacific moorings, DOISST minus buoy SST rises by +0.064 C per decade (95% interval 0.030-0.096) over 1993-2022; other products stay within +/-0.013. The differences are steps at input-change dates (mainly 2005-01-01 and 2020-07-07). Steps fitted to one reference type remove the errors against the other type and at the moorings (residual 0.000-0.005). The west-minus-east Pacific gradient trend and the SST# rise survive. OI v2 keeps the observed 1982-2022 pattern, but it has an undocumented Southern Hemisphere cold step in about mid-2018 (-0.10 to -0.15 C at 40-60S against in situ data) that changes the sign of its 2001-2022 50-60S trend. Limitations: the references disagree by up to 0.04 C per decade; CCI has its own step near 2018 and cannot confirm the OI v2 step; we did not calculate radiative feedback.

Dashed: east equatorial Pacific box and 40-60S.

1982-2022 trends of six pattern indices by product. Grey band: range of the four independent references (ERSSTv5, COBE-SST2, HadSST4.2, ESA CCI v3). DOISST (orange) lies outside the band for the east Pacific and the Southern Ocean; step-corrected DOISST (green, blue) and OI v2 (violet) lie inside or near it.

Monthly difference series (12-month running means): (a) DOISST minus each reference and minus TAO moorings, Nino 3.4 / east box; (b) DOISST minus each reference, 40-60S; (c) OI v2 minus each reference, 40-60S, with the Pinatubo period and the 2018 step. Dotted lines: input-change or break dates.
